lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: accusative masculine indefinite (form III) verbal noun
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: كِفَاتًا is in the derivative form: كِفَات
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ك/ف/ت   k–f–t to alter, to change; to detain, hiding place, place for burying things/people; to compete; difficulty; livelihood; small cooking pot, to sheathe; death. Of this root, كِفَات kifāt occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
كِفَات kifāt [v. n. as n. of place] terrain, territory, holding place, home, habitat, environment

(77:25–6) أَحْيَاءً وَأَمْوَاتًا كِفَاتًا أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ الأَرْضَ did We not make the earth a home for the living and the dead?
